title: Coordinates on Chat
description: You want to share your coordinates with your friends? Just press a button and thats done
body:
Simple, quick, useful!

This little mod allows you to automatically post your current coordinates to the game chat by pressing the P key - perfect for exploring, base marking or sharing your position with other players.

🔧 Functions:
A single press of the P key will bring you into the chat

No need to open F3!

Useful for survival, PvP or SMP servers.

🧩 Compatibility:
Minecraft: 1.20.1

Forge: Forge Loader for 1.20.1

🎮 Usage:
Start the game with the mod.

Press the P button anywhere in the world.

Check your coordinates in the chat!
